decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Restriction on Permitted DevelopmentNotwithstanding the provisions of Article 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) no windows or other openings (other than those expressly authorised by this permission) shall be formed in the walls or roof of the extension permitted.

Condition : 5 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed erection of a single storey side and rear extension, by reason of positioning, size, scale, design and appearance, are considered to be acceptable having due regard for the existing building, the site characteristics, the street scene and the immediate local area.  The proposal would not be harmful to the character and appearance of the house, the street scene or local area; neither would it have an undue effect on and be harmful to the amenities of any neighbouring properties.  The development is considered to be in accordance with the relevant provisions of adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), and ENV-H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions), of the adopted Unitary Development Plan (2003), and the Supplementary Planning Guidance (Residential Extension Guidelines).
description: Demolition of existing garage and outbuildings and erection of single storey side and rear extensions to house
